data.name: Lailaishah
data.gender_notes: Lailaishah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lailaishah is a compound name derived from 'Laila' meaning 'night' and 'Shah' meaning 'play' or 'game'. It signifies a playful or delightful presence under the night. The name Lailaishah carries the meaning “Night, Play, or Game” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lailaishah usually hope their child will grow to embody night, play, or game and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Lailaishah can be associated with the Quranic description of the night as a time for reflection and peace (Quran 89:2-4).
data.etymology: Lailaishah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night, Play, or Game.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lailaishah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_urdu.name: لائلائشہ
in_urdu.meaning: لائلائشہ تعنی لیلۂ قدر اور مبارکہ ساعت
in_urdu.long_meaning: لائلائشہ ایک مرکب نام ہے جو لیلاء اور ایشہ سے ملا ہے، لیلاء کا مطلب ہے لیلۂ قدر جو اسلام میں ایک مبارکہ رات ہے، اور ایشہ کا مطلب ہے مبارکہ ساعت، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلم معاشرے میں روایتی اور مذہبی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: लैलाइशा
